name: mpack_search
description: Search and browse the Metalcraft Packs registry. Returns an array of pack summaries: {slug, name, description, version, tags, requires_env, tool_count, persona_count, skill_count, flow_count, install_count, verified, featured}. All params optional: `q` (free-text filter over name/description), `tag` (filter to a tag), `sort` ('installs' default, 'name', or 'new'), `limit`. Use this to find a pack, then mpack_get for its full detail.

tag.description: Only return packs carrying this tag.
